task.description: This fix's regression coverage is the 3 pre-existing tests T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS, F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ, F-H6-FIRES-NEW in test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs, which ISSUE-FIXER (Step 01) confirmed FAIL on pre-fix code (17/20 passed, those 3 failing) and ELIXIR-DEV (Step 03) confirmed PASS on post-fix code (20/20). Per WF-03_issue_resolving.md's Step 4 rule, this fail-then-pass proof must be independently demonstrated, not merely inherited from two different prior agents' separate claims. Your job: independently reproduce BOTH halves yourself, in a way that isolates the regression from anything else that changed. Preferred technique (per WF-03_issue_resolving.md's isolation note): use a throwaway git worktree checked out at the pre-fix commit (feature/WF03-ISS0273-20260822~<N before the ELIXIR-DEV implementation commit>, or simplest: main, since main does not yet have this fix) plus ONLY the current test file copied in, run mix test against it, quote failing output; then run the same test file against the current branch (post-fix), quote passing output. If the existing 3 tests are not adequate as a fail-then-pass proof for some reason you find during this exercise, add whatever minimal additional test coverage is needed and explain why. Clean up any worktree/throwaway artifacts when done and verify git status --porcelain is empty of anything unintended.
acceptance_criteria: Independently reproduced pre-fix FAIL (quoted real output) for the 3 assertions, isolated via worktree-at-main plus only the test file, not inherited from Step 01's report
Independently reproduced post-fix PASS (quoted real output) on the feature branch
Stated whether existing coverage is sufficient or additional tests were needed, with reasoning
Any worktree/throwaway artifact created for this verification is removed, git status --porcelain confirmed clean

result.summary:
This is the ordinary existing-behavior fail-then-pass case, not the mutant/non-existence clause: h6_floor_commit/0, resolve_h6_floor_commit/0 (removed by this fix), and pre_floor_file?/2 are all pre-existing functions from ISS-0262, and the 3 regression tests already exist -- confirmed by the test file's own moduledoc note (lines 10-20) recording the same conclusion for its original ISS-0262 authorship. Independently reproduced BOTH halves myself, isolated via a throwaway `git worktree add --detach ../wt-iss0273-prefix main` (git fetch origin main -q first; origin/main == local main == 8e3a9644073fae9dc44cf61bdfcda2c798a0e01d, confirmed pre-fix via `git show main:lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex | grep -n h6_floor_commit` showing `@h6_floor_commit "BOOTSTRAP"` still literal on line 133, i.e. main does NOT have the ISS-0273 fix). Diffed the current branch's test file against the worktree's copy first (`diff test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs ../wt-iss0273-prefix/...` -> identical, 0 output) -- confirming ELIXIR-DEV's claim of 'no test file changes' directly rather than trusting it, so no file copy was actually needed to satisfy 'plus ONLY the current test file'; the fixture test/fixtures/lint_handoffs/h6/step-01-fixture-non-json.md already exists on main (added in the same commit, 184d846, as the H6 check itself).

PRE-FIX (worktree at main, `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs`): 'Result: 17/20 passed, Failed: 3 tests' -- the exact same 3: (1) T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS at line 297, `assert [violation] = result.hard_new` got `right: []`; (2) F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ at line 127, `assert [%{rule: "H6"}] = result.hard_new` got `right: []`; (3) F-H6-FIRES-NEW at line 106, `assert [violation] = result.hard_new` got `right: []`. This matches Step 01's ISSUE-FIXER report exactly, but is now independently demonstrated rather than inherited.

Worktree removed immediately after: `git worktree remove ../wt-iss0273-prefix --force`, confirmed via `git worktree list` showing only the main checkout remains.

POST-FIX (current feature branch, same command): confirmed `@h6_floor_commit` is pinned to `c4a8e39729e253397d4f1aa34155a74522930252` via grep, then `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs` -> 'Result: 20 passed', 0 failures.

EXISTING COVERAGE ADEQUACY: sufficient, no additional tests added. Reasoning: the 3 failing-then-passing assertions exercise lint_file/2's real production call path (no explicit floor arg) end to end through h6_floor_commit/0 -> pre_floor_file?/2 -> ancestor_or_equal?/2, which is exactly the mechanism ISS-0273's bug lived in (the now-deleted resolve_h6_floor_commit/0 dynamic re-resolution). The fail run proves the suite is sensitive to the specific defect (a moving floor misclassifying a genuinely-new file as grandfathered); the pass run proves the fix removes it. The other 17 tests (JSON H1-H5 behavior, T-PRE-FLOOR-* direct pre_floor_file?/2 unit tests, T-H6-ZERO-NEW corpus check) were unaffected in both runs, confirming isolation -- no unrelated coverage regressed or was needed to make this pass.

Cleanup verification: `git status --porcelain` in the main working tree shows only this handoff file (`M handoffs/WF03-ISS0273-20260822/step-04-test-designer.json`) -- the one intentional edit this step makes; `git worktree list` shows no leftover worktree. No test file or lib/ file was modified by this step.
